# Aayan Cotton Industries

> Aayan Cotton Industries (ACI) is Pakistan's premier medical devices and absorbent & non-absorbent cotton wool rolls manufacturer since 2000. Exporting to 20+ countries worldwide.

- [Home](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#home)
- [About Us](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#about)

- [Certificates](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#certificates)
- [Contact Us](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#contact)

## Overview
Aayan Cotton Industries (ACI) is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, CE, and GMP certified medical devices manufacturer located in Depalpur Road, Okara, Punjab, Pakistan.

## Key Products & Specialties
- [Absorbent Cotton Wool Rolls](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#products)
- [Non-Absorbent Cotton Wool Rolls](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#products)
- [Orthopedic Undercast Padding](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#products)
- [Surgical Dressings & Gauze Swabs](https://aayan-cotton.vercel.app/#products)

## Company Details
- Location: Depalpur Road, Okara, Punjab, Pakistan
